title: Kleine Suite, Op. 47
identity: Marius Flothuis, Kleine Suite (Vocalises), Op. 47 (1952), was originally for soprano and piano. Donemus catalog data says the soprano part is also playable by oboe, clarinet, soprano saxophone, or trumpet. It gives five movements, nine-minute duration, and product 01556. A separate work, Op. 47a (1952/1995), is for soprano, flute, strings, and harp; do not conflate it with Op. 47.

evidence.claim: Donemus catalog record for Kleine Suite (Vocalises), Op. 47, 1952, identifies soprano and piano; remarks say the soprano part is also performable on oboe, clarinet, soprano saxophone, or trumpet. It lists five movements, nine minutes, and 16-page score/8-page part.
A separate Donemus record identifies Op. 47a (1952/1995) for soprano, flute, string trio and harp, adapted from Op. 47 for soprano and piano.
KNMO 2010 wind repertoire index separately lists Flothuis, Kleine Suite, solo soprano saxophone, Donemus, in its division system.

review_focus: Inference from the verified vocalise scoring: inspect how breathing and articulation shape the wordless vocal line; there is no text-based phrasing to follow.
collection_flag: Donemus confirms a soprano-saxophone option by substitution of the soprano vocalise part; no intended age group is established.
